display.purpose: Page h1s; case titles run to clamp(48px, 7.4vw, 120px).

ledger.purpose: The home h1 as ruled credit rows: stage name, dotted leader, italic credit.

numeral.purpose: The n/6 above each work's title; denominator in regular weight Faint Graphite.

headline.purpose: Section h2s; the commission call and colophon name are the oversized exceptions.

title.purpose: h3s; work titles and process stages scale up inside their rows.

lede.purpose: One plain sentence under a display heading, press ink, max 34ch.

body.purpose: Running text in graphite; 16px at 1023px and below; reading measure 58 to 62ch.

label.purpose: Buttons, inline links and the nav call to action.

meta.purpose: Presentation meta, definition terms, form labels (at 600), filter chips.

fine.purpose: Status lines, hints, errors, caption types, inscription meta.

note.purpose: Libre Caslon italic: section asides, catalogue notes, outcomes, captions, footer colophon. Always italic.

inscription.purpose: Libre Caslon italic: plate titles and the maker's hand. The edition fraction inside switches to the grotesk, 15px/500 tabular.

data.purpose: System monospace for checksums and the copyable brief only.

shadows.name: mount
shadows.purpose: Under every plate sheet and the mobile-story mount.

shadows.name: deboss
shadows.purpose: The plate mark recessed into the mount.

shadows.name: struck-sheet
shadows.purpose: The selected tab in the hero sheet stack, shifted 8px toward the plate.

shadows.name: paper-edge
shadows.purpose: Leading edge of the translucent overlay as a plate is pulled.

shadows.name: press
shadows.purpose: A button while held, with 1px downward travel.

shadows.name: field-focus
shadows.purpose: Doubles a field's underline to 2px press on focus (textarea: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--press)).

shadows.name: focus-ring
shadows.purpose: Global focus-visible ring; slab paper on the ink slab. Not a box-shadow; recorded here because the schema has no focus group.

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: Default curve for state changes, line draws and arrivals.

motion.name: ease-pull
motion.purpose: The paper overlay lifting off a plate.

motion.name: t-feedback
motion.purpose: Button, chip and tab fills and press travel.

motion.name: t-state
motion.purpose: Underline draws, arrow nudges, header change, mobile menu drop.

motion.name: t-arrival
motion.purpose: Rules drawing on entry, sections rising 18px, image hover scale.

motion.name: t-pull
motion.purpose: Plate pull: overlay lift and plate-mark border draw.

motion.name: plate-morph
motion.purpose: Shared view transition from a plate into its case-study hero.

motion.name: ledger-arrival
motion.value: rules 900ms (stagger 80ms); stage names 820ms from a clipped line; credits 500ms from 520ms + 90ms per row

motion.name: sheet-settle
motion.purpose: Hero plate sheet settling on load.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: prefers-reduced-motion: state and feedback remain, wipes and movement do not.

narrative.overview:
The site is handled like a print room's portfolio box. The page is a warm rag-white sheet, everything a visitor must read to decide is set in press ink, annotation is graphite pencil, and the only colour is a small vermilion seal stamped where a logo would usually sit. Every project is treated as a numbered print: mounted on a lighter sheet, framed by a debossed plate mark, and inscribed underneath in italic with its title, its number in the edition and the maker's hand.

Authorship is the organising idea, and it is expressed with printers' devices rather than marketing furniture: credits on a ruled ledger, edition fractions (n/6), catalogue entries with provenance and checksums, a colophon in place of an about card. Structure is drawn with hairline rules, never boxes. Density is generous and editorial: very large, tightly tracked grotesk display type held against quiet italic notes, with each work composed as its own spread on a twelve-column grid so no two neighbouring projects share a layout.

Motion follows the physics of paper and ink. Lines draw from the left, plates are pulled (a translucent paper overlay lifts off the image while the plate mark draws its border), a chosen sheet is struck forward at once with no cross-fade, and a plate carries over into its case-study hero as a shared view transition. Hover is a refinement reserved for fine pointers; reduced motion removes travel and wipes while every state stays legible.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper neutrals and a single press-black ink; colour appears only in the vermilion chop and its marks.
Two voices: Schibsted Grotesk for the work and every control, Libre Caslon italic as the pencil (inscriptions, credits, notes).
Works are mounted plates with inscriptions, never cards.
1px hairline rules carry all structure; every corner is square.
Every count is an edition mark in tabular lining figures.
The ink slab (a press-black field) appears only behind the commission call and the footer colophon.
Motion draws, pulls and strikes; works switch instantly.

rules.name: The Stamp, Not Paint Rule
rules.body: Vermilion is applied only as a mark: the chop seal, squares of 8px or less, the focus outline and the caret. It never fills a button, never colours a heading or a link, never tints a surface. Chop Ink carries error text and nothing else.

rules.name: The Paper and Ink Rule
rules.body: Every surface is paper (sheet, mount, deboss) or ink (the slab). There is no tinted panel, no grey card and no third surface colour, and the slab appears only behind the commission call and the footer.

rules.name: The Pencil Rule
rules.body: Graphite annotates; press ink is for what the visitor reads to decide or act. Faint Graphite is permitted only at display size.

rules.name: The Two Hands Rule
rules.body: The grotesk sets anything that is the work or acts: headings, body, navigation, buttons, numbers. Caslon italic sets attribution and annotation only: inscriptions, credits, notes, captions, the Required/Optional mark beside a field label. Caslon never sets a heading, a button or a number.

rules.name: The Edition Mark Rule
rules.body: Every count is a tabular lining figure in the grotesk: n/6 fractions, stage indexes, sheet-tab numbers, the studio clock.

rules.name: The Label-On-The-Object Rule
rules.body: Labels sit on the thing they name: the inscription under the plate, the numeral at display size as part of a work's heading, the note beside a section heading rather than above it. A small label stacked above a heading is not part of this system.

rules.name: The Spread Rule
rules.body: Each work gets its own composition on the twelve-column grid, and neighbouring works never share a layout. A uniform grid of project cards is not part of this system.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: Structure is ruled, not boxed: 1px Hairline between rows, Strong Hairline for ledgers and controls, a press-ink rule across the top of a list, form or profile. Lists of facts, deliverables, stages, commissions and contact routes are separated by rules with no container around them.

rules.name: The Paper Physics Rule
rules.body: Only paper objects cast shadows: mounts, debossed marks, a struck sheet, a lifting overlay. Buttons, rows, fields and navigation stay flat; a button receives only the inset press while held.

rules.name: The Translucent Paper Rule
rules.body: Blur appears in two places only: the scrolled header (Glassine over a 12px blur) and the overlay lifting off a plate (10px blur, desaturated). There are no frosted panels.

rules.name: The Square Rule
rules.body: Nothing is rounded. If an element must read as a mark, it is a square.

dos: Do mount every screenshot as a plate: Mount Board (#f8f7f3) with the Mount shadow, a Plate Deboss (#ebeae4) mark with a 1px Strong Hairline border, the image, then an italic inscription with title, n/6 and the hand.

Do draw structure with 1px rules: Hairline (#d6d3ca) between rows, Strong Hairline (#b3afa4) for ledgers, Faint Graphite (#8a877f) for control outlines, Press Ink (#151413) across the top of a list, form or profile.
Do keep vermilion (#cf3a1e) to the chop, squares of 8px or less, the 2px focus outline at 4px offset, and the caret.
Do set every count (n/6, stage index, tab number, clock) in tabular lining figures.
Do give each work its own spread on the twelve-column grid: mirrored, paired with a companion plate, or desktop beside phone.
Do animate lines by drawing them from the left and plates by pulling the paper off; switch between works instantly.
Do gate hover effects behind `(hover: hover) and (pointer: fine)` and give each one a focus-visible equivalent.
Do keep every interactive target at 44px or more (52px buttons, 64px mobile menu rows).
Do reserve the ink slab (#151413) for the commission call and the footer.
donts: Don't round any corner; the radius is 0px throughout.
Don't put projects or content in tinted, bordered or shadowed cards; works are plates and facts are ruled rows.
Don't stack a small label, kicker or numbered eyebrow above a heading; labels live on the object.
Don't set headings, buttons, navigation or numbers in Libre Caslon, or annotation in the grotesk.
Don't use vermilion for text, button fills, links or any area larger than the chop; errors use Chop Ink (#b0301a).
Don't cross-fade between works; the selected sheet is struck forward at once.
Don't give buttons, rows, fields or navigation a drop shadow; the only control shadow is the inset press while a button is held.
Don't use Faint Graphite (#8a877f) for text smaller than display size; it is reserved for display numerals and control boundaries.
Don't stand in a stock or generated portrait, a signature image or a client-logo strip; the chop and the colophon carry identity.
